platforms.name: Blogger
platforms.publishMethod: api:googleapis.com/blogger/v3/blogs/{blog_id}/posts (OAuth2 bearer)
platforms.notes: Google Blogger; free {user}.blogspot.com. Real BloggerClient (OAuth2).

platforms.name: Codeberg Pages
platforms.publishMethod: api: CodebergPagesClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - Gitea Contents API, PUT /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path} to commit a static file to the `pages` branch, `Authorization: token <TOKEN>`
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Non-profit, EU-hosted Gitea instance; mirrors GitHubPagesClient almost exactly (Gitea's Contents API is API-compatible with GitHub's).

platforms.name: dev.to
platforms.publishMethod: api:dev.to/api/articles (api-key header, Forem API v1)
platforms.notes: Forem developer blog. Real DevToClient (plain api-key header, no OAuth).

platforms.name: Disqus
platforms.publishMethod: api: DisqusClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - OAuth2, POST /users/updateProfile.json (url + about fields) - a THIN PROFILE placement, not an article
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live, but honestly a profile placement (Disqus has no article-publish endpoint for a 3rd-party integration). Self-serve OAuth2 app registration confirmed current, no manual review found.
platforms.adapterStatus: Thin placement: a profile field, not a content page - counted as reference diversity, not link equity.

platforms.name: dpaste.org
platforms.publishMethod: anonymous: DpasteClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - POST https://dpaste.org/api/ with no key or cookie at all
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Simplest possible anonymous POST, confirmed current in the official docs. No edit endpoint - every publish is a new paste.
platforms.adapterStatus: Paste site: a link placement here reads as a spam signal, not a citation or a content property - excluded from link building by the provider plan.

platforms.name: Drupal
platforms.publishMethod: api: DrupalClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - core JSON:API (ships in core >= 8.7, no contrib module), HTTP Basic with an API-only Drupal user; POST/PATCH /jsonapi/node/<content_type>
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Auth is HTTP Basic against a client-provisioned Drupal user - Basic-auth requests are exempt from Drupal's cookie-session CSRF check, so no separate token handshake is needed. Self-hosted, so authority varies by the specific site.

platforms.name: FC2 Blog
platforms.publishMethod: api: FC2BlogClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - legacy metaWeblog XML-RPC (metaWeblog.newPost/getPost) at http://blog.fc2.com/xmlrpc.php, username + password (no OAuth on this legacy protocol)
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Shares the _MetaWeblogClient base with Seesaa Blog (identical protocol, different endpoint). getPost fetches the real permalink rather than guessing a subdomain URL pattern.

platforms.name: Figshare
platforms.publishMethod: api: FigshareClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - POST https://api.figshare.com/v2/account/articles (raw `token` auth, not Bearer), then an explicit POST .../publish call
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Two-step create-then-publish, mirrors Zenodo's own design. Public URL uses Figshare's stable DOI convention rather than a guessed title-slug web path.

platforms.name: Ghost
platforms.publishMethod: api:{site}/ghost/api/admin/posts/ (short-lived Admin JWT from id:secret)
platforms.notes: Ghost(Pro) or self-hosted. Real GhostClient (Admin API key signs a per-call JWT).

platforms.name: GitHub Gist
platforms.publishMethod: api: GitHubGistClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - POST https://api.github.com/gists with a PAT Bearer, public:true
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. High-DA, self-serve PAT. Gist links are typically nofollow - best for reference/citation diversity.

platforms.name: GitHub Pages
platforms.publishMethod: api:api.github.com Contents API PUT (PAT) + ensure Pages enabled
platforms.notes: Static site on {user}.github.io. Real GitHubPagesClient (PAT, two-step commit + enable).

platforms.name: GitLab Pages
platforms.publishMethod: api:gitlab.com/api/v4 Repository Files (PAT) + a CI pages job
platforms.notes: Static site on {namespace}.gitlab.io. Real GitLabPagesClient (PAT; verified=false pending CI).
platforms.adapterStatus: Publishes into a Pages deployment the pipeline cannot fetch - verified stays pending by design, excluded from link counts.

platforms.name: GitLab Snippets
platforms.publishMethod: api: GitLabSnippetsClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - POST https://gitlab.com/api/v4/snippets with PRIVATE-TOKEN PAT, visibility=public
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. High-DA, self-serve PAT, no app approval.

platforms.name: Gravatar
platforms.publishMethod: api: GravatarClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - api.gravatar.com/v3 Bearer token, PATCH /me (description + a links[] entry) - a THIN PROFILE placement, not an article
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live, but honestly a profile placement (Gravatar has no article concept). Automattic's 2024+ v3 REST API confirmed current in 2026.
platforms.adapterStatus: Thin placement: a profile field, not a content page - counted as reference diversity, not link equity.

platforms.name: HackMD
platforms.publishMethod: api: HackMDClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - POST /v1/notes at api.hackmd.io, Bearer PAT (self-issued, Settings > API), readPermission: guest for a publicly-viewable publishLink
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Token self-serve, no approval.

platforms.name: Hashnode
platforms.publishMethod: api:gql.hashnode.com GraphQL publishPost (RAW PAT header, not Bearer)
platforms.notes: Developer blog. Real HashnodeClient (GraphQL Public API; needs a publication_id).
platforms.adapterStatus: API access paywalled since 2026-05-13 - publishing requires a paid plan (owner decision pending: pay, or demote to the human lane).

platforms.name: Hatena Blog
platforms.publishMethod: api:blog.hatena.ne.jp/{id}/{blog}/atom AtomPub (HTTP Basic)
platforms.notes: Major Japanese blog host. Real HatenaBlogClient (AtomPub, HTTP Basic with the API key).

platforms.name: HubSpot CMS
platforms.publishMethod: api: HubSpotClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - CMS Blog Post API v3, private-app Bearer token; POST/PATCH /cms/v3/blogs/posts against an existing content_group_id (blog)
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Needs an existing HubSpot blog (content_group_id) to post into - no default blog. Private-app token is self-serve from Settings > Integrations > Private Apps. High-DA, marketing-grade CMS.

platforms.name: Hygraph
platforms.publishMethod: api: HygraphClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - GraphQL Content API, `create{Model}` then `publish{Model}(to: PUBLISHED)`, Bearer Permanent Auth Token
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Headless Content API only - no rendered public page of its own, so verified is always false; post_url points at the Content API endpoint, not a public page. GraphQL model name (model, default "post") and its title/slug/content fields are project-schema-specific.
platforms.adapterStatus: Headless entry with no public rendered page - a placement here is never link-verified, so it is excluded from link counts.

platforms.name: Joomla
platforms.publishMethod: api: JoomlaClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - core Web Services API (com_content), per-user "API Token" (Joomla 4.3+, User > Edit > API Token); POST/PATCH /api/index.php/v1/content/articles
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Response carries no absolute public URL (SEF routing is site-configured), so the client builds the always-resolvable non-SEF permalink (index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=<id>) rather than guessing a pretty slug. Self-hosted, wide quality variance -> authority_tier=low.

platforms.name: Lemmy (lemmy.world)
platforms.publishMethod: api: LemmyClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - POST /api/v3/user/login for a JWT, resolve the target community name to an id, then POST /api/v3/post as a link post (url=backlink, body=article text)
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Open self-serve signup confirmed current (Lemmy 1.0.0 open beta, May 2026); still exposes the same v3 API.

platforms.name: Livedoor Blog
platforms.publishMethod: api: LivedoorBlogClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - AtomPub POST https://livedoor.blogcms.jp/atompub/{blog}/article, HTTP Basic with the Livedoor ID + a separately-issued AtomPub API key (never the account password)
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Same AtomPub protocol as HatenaBlogClient - reuses its Atom-entry XML builder/parser directly.

platforms.name: Mastodon
platforms.publishMethod: api:{instance}/api/v1/statuses (OAuth2 bearer, per-instance)
platforms.notes: Federated microblog. Real MastodonClient (OAuth2 bearer, per-instance).

platforms.name: Minds
platforms.publishMethod: api: MindsClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - Bearer personal access token, POST /api/v3/newsfeed/activity to the account's public channel
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Minds.com confirmed operating (status page + developer docs current) in 2026.

platforms.name: Misskey (misskey.io)
platforms.publishMethod: api: MisskeyClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - POST /api/notes/create with the access token IN the JSON body (`i`), not a header - a documented Misskey quirk
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Distinct fediverse software from Mastodon - its own client. No note-edit endpoint - every publish is a new note.

platforms.name: Neocities
platforms.publishMethod: api: NeocitiesClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - multipart POST https://neocities.org/api/upload with a Bearer site API key
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Free static host, self-serve API key.

platforms.name: Netlify
platforms.publishMethod: api: NetlifyClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - the digest deploy flow (POST .../deploys with a sha1 file digest, PUT the file only if required) against an existing site_id
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. One deploy replaces the whole site's prior deploy - one branded property per Netlify site.

platforms.name: Notion
platforms.publishMethod: api: NotionClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - api.notion.com Pages API creates a real page under a pre-existing parent_page_id; verified=False always (no API to flip "Share to web")
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live, but always verified=False: confirmed against 2026 docs that making a page public is STILL a human, UI-only toggle - a person must open the created page and share it before it is a live, indexable placement.
platforms.adapterStatus: Headless entry with no public rendered page - a placement here is never link-verified, so it is excluded from link counts.

platforms.name: OSF
platforms.publishMethod: api: OSFClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - POST https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/ (JSON:API), Bearer token, explicitly sets public: true (OSF nodes default PRIVATE otherwise)
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Center for Open Science, self-serve personal access token, confirmed current in 2026.

platforms.name: paste.ee
platforms.publishMethod: api: PasteEeClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - POST https://api.paste.ee/v1/pastes with X-Auth-Token header + sections[].contents
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. No documented edit endpoint - every publish is a new paste.
platforms.adapterStatus: Paste site: a link placement here reads as a spam signal, not a citation or a content property - excluded from link building by the provider plan.

platforms.name: Pixelfed (pixelfed.social)
platforms.publishMethod: api: PixelfedClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - Mastodon-compatible REST, but uploads a fixed brand placeholder_image_url as required media before POST /api/v1/statuses
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Requires an image per post (unlike Mastodon) - solved with a fixed brand placeholder image fetched + uploaded each publish.
platforms.adapterStatus: Image-mandatory: every post requires media - text-only placements are structurally impossible here.

platforms.name: Plurk
platforms.publishMethod: api: PlurkClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - OAuth1 (hand-rolled HMAC-SHA1 signing), POST plurkAdd to the account timeline
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Site confirmed active in 2026; the one OAuth1 (not OAuth2) platform in this catalog.

platforms.name: rentry.co
platforms.publishMethod: anonymous: RentryClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - POST https://rentry.co/api/new with a CSRF cookie handshake, no account/credential at all
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Unofficial-but-actively-maintained endpoint (community clients still updated in 2026); the returned edit_code is the only write credential for later updates.
platforms.adapterStatus: Paste site: a link placement here reads as a spam signal, not a citation or a content property - excluded from link building by the provider plan.

platforms.name: Sanity
platforms.publishMethod: api: SanityClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - POST https://{project_id}.api.sanity.io/v2024-01-01/data/mutate/{dataset}, Bearer API token, one `create`/`createOrReplace` mutation per publish
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Headless Content Lake only - no rendered public page of its own, so verified is always false; post_url is a best-effort Sanity Studio deep link. Document `_type` (doc_type, default "post") is project-schema-specific.
platforms.adapterStatus: Headless entry with no public rendered page - a placement here is never link-verified, so it is excluded from link counts.

platforms.name: Seesaa Blog
platforms.publishMethod: api: SeesaaBlogClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - the SAME metaWeblog XML-RPC protocol as FC2 Blog, endpoint https://ssl.seesaa.jp/blog/rpc (the SSL endpoint, preferred over the plain-HTTP one), username + password
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Shares the _MetaWeblogClient base with FC2 Blog.

platforms.name: Sourcehut Pages
platforms.publishMethod: api: SourcehutPagesClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - GraphQL POST https://pages.sr.ht/query, a `publish(domain, content)` mutation taking a tarball Upload, sent as a standard GraphQL multipart request built entirely from the stdlib (tarfile + io.BytesIO)
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. SourceHut confirmed operating in 2026; the GraphQL schema + the graphql-multipart-request-spec are both concretely documented, unlike GitBook's content-push flow.

platforms.name: Storyblok
platforms.publishMethod: api: StoryblokClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - POST/PUT https://mapi.storyblok.com/v1/spaces/{space_id}/stories?publish=1, a raw (non-Bearer) Management API personal access token
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Headless CMS - the story auto-publishes into the space's live content, but rendering it still needs the client's own frontend, so verified stays false; post_url is a best-effort editor deep link. Story `component` (default "page") is space-schema-specific.
platforms.adapterStatus: Headless entry with no public rendered page - a placement here is never link-verified, so it is excluded from link counts.

platforms.name: Telegra.ph
platforms.publishMethod: api:api.telegra.ph/createPage (anonymous access_token from createAccount)

platforms.name: Tumblr
platforms.publishMethod: api:api.tumblr.com/v2/blog/{blog}/post (OAuth2 bearer)
platforms.notes: Microblog; free {user}.tumblr.com. Real TumblrClient (OAuth2).

platforms.name: Warpcast
platforms.publishMethod: api: WarpcastClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - POST https://api.neynar.com/v2/farcaster/cast via Neynar, `x-api-key` header (NOT Authorization Bearer) + a pre-approved signer_uuid credential
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Farcaster/Neynar confirmed current in 2026. The signer-approval handshake happens once, outside this system, by the account owner. Permalink uses the documented short-hash convention; falls back to verified=false if the response omits a username.

platforms.name: Webflow
platforms.publishMethod: api: WebflowClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - Data API v2, Bearer site token; PATCH/POST the CMS item then POST .../publish so the collection item goes live at once (two-step, mirrors GitHubPagesClient's commit-then-enable-Pages honesty)
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Free Starter site gives a *.webflow.io staging subdomain (Webflow branding, no custom domain, capped pages/CMS items on the free tier). Token self-serve in site settings.

platforms.name: WhiteWind (Bluesky/ATProto long-form)
platforms.publishMethod: api: WhiteWindClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - reuses the SAME Bluesky/ATProto session, writes a com.whtwnd.blog.entry record via XRPC; renders as a public HTML article at whtwnd.com
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Confirmed still operating in 2026 (active repo/updates). The genuine long-form counterpart to Bluesky's short post - no grapheme cap.

platforms.name: WordPress.com
platforms.publishMethod: api:public-api.wordpress.com/rest/v1.1/sites/{site}/posts (OAuth2 bearer)
platforms.notes: Hosted WordPress; free {user}.wordpress.com subdomain. Real WordPressComClient.

platforms.name: Write.as
platforms.publishMethod: api:write.as/api/collections/{alias}/posts (bearer; anonymous posting also supported)
platforms.notes: Write.as/WriteFreely. Real WriteAsClient (bearer token; empty target posts anonymously).
platforms.adapterStatus: Signups closed ("Closed for now") and free-tier links are nofollow (do-follow is a paid feature) - no defensible placement exists.

platforms.name: WriteFreely
platforms.publishMethod: api: WriteFreelyEuClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - POST {instance_url}/api/posts (or /api/collections/{target}/posts), the identical WriteFreely/Write.as protocol, optional Bearer token (anonymous posting supported)
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Generalizes PLATFORM_WRITEAS to a caller-chosen instance_url. Several open public instances are individually EU-operator-run (per the official writefreely.org/instances directory), but each is a volunteer-run community project with no SLA - pick and verify one live instance before use, and treat it as lower-reliability than every corporate-operated platform in this catalog.

platforms.name: Zenodo

platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. CERN-operated, self-serve token, confirmed current in 2026. Publish is one-way - a second publish() call against an already-published record re-fetches instead of erroring.

platforms.name: Nostr long-form (YakiHonne / Habla.news)
platforms.publishMethod: api: generate a Nostr keypair (or use a NIP-07 signer), sign and publish a kind:30023 long-form event to relays; web frontends render it as a crawlable HTML article at yakihonne.com / habla.news
platforms.notes: Nostr NIP-23 long-form. No gatekeeper at all - create a key and publish. YakiHonne and Habla.news render public, crawlable article pages. Emerging/low authority; value is protocol diversification + a censorship-resistant mirror of content.
platforms.adapterStatus: Excluded by the provider plan: keypair-published protocol content with no moderation or takedown path is not a defensible client placement.

platforms.name: Pastebin.com
platforms.publishMethod: api: PastebinClient (integrations/web2_publishers.py) - POST https://pastebin.com/api/api_post.php (form-encoded, returns a bare text url) with api_dev_key + api_option=paste
platforms.notes: Real Web2Publisher live. Classic api_dev_key still live for free accounts. No edit endpoint reachable with just the dev key - every publish is a new paste.
platforms.adapterStatus: Paste site: a link placement here reads as a spam signal, not a citation or a content property - excluded from link building by the provider plan.
